# SomniSmart

> SomniSmart (https://somnismart.com) is a free, science-based mattress advisor. Visitors answer a few questions and get a transparent shortlist of currently available mattresses, ranked only by matching rules — not by commission.

## How it works

- Starts from medium-firm (about 6/10), the evidence-based default for most adults.
- Adjusts for body weight and BMI (from height and weight): higher BMI shifts firmer toward thicker, higher-density models; lower BMI leans softer.
- Adjusts for sleep position: side softer for shoulder/hip pressure relief, back medium-firm, stomach firmer, combination medium to medium-firm.
- Adjusts for body shape: curvy hips with a narrow waist cap firmness at medium-firm with a softer comfort layer or zoned support; broad-shouldered side sleepers get extra shoulder pressure relief.
- Considers conditions such as back or joint pain, sleeping hot, and motion isolation, and can take answers for both you and a partner.
- Material preference: Organic swaps in GOTS/GOLS-certified models (Avocado Green, Saatva Latex Hybrid or Zenhaven, Birch Natural); Natural swaps in natural latex/wool/cotton models with no polyurethane foam; Commonly accepted as safe keeps the standard picks and lists their CertiPUR-US / GREENGUARD Gold certifications. Firmness and body rules still apply.

## Results

Each recommendation shows:
1. Best science match
2. Most practical
3. Best value
4. Custom Made — always Chirobed by Spine Align (https://chirobed.com), made-to-order mattresses. Chirobed is SomniSmart's own brand, and this is disclosed on the site.

Some shop links may be affiliate links; picks are chosen on fit alone. SomniSmart is informational and not medical advice.
